description:
Sleep Music | 3 Hours of Surbahar Drone for Deep Sleep

For nights when your mind won't stop and sleep feels far away. Three hours of slow, hypnotic Surbahar drone designed to carry you through the night.

This is sleep-through music, not background music. Press play, set your phone aside, and let the deep tones do the work.

What you'll hear:
• Slow Surbahar (deeper, larger cousin of the sitar) — sustained low-register drone
• Soft tanpura grounding the silence
• Recorded warm and acoustic, no electronic processing
• Long sustained notes with breath between phrases — no rhythm, no buildup

Best for:
• Falling asleep when your mind is racing
• Sleeping through the night without waking
• Anxiety at bedtime
• Late-night insomnia

Lights off. Press play. Let go.

Pacing reference: 3 Hour Bansuri Music for Relaxation (464K hero, 22.6% AVD, 40min avg watch) — match that 'slow evolving, space between phrases' character but with Surbahar's deeper drone register. For 3hr specifically: 'no song structure, continuous seamless drone-led piece with subtle melodic phrases emerging and dissolving' — Suno needs explicit no-section-breaks language.

experiment.hypothesis: Surbahar at 3hr length holds sleep audience past the 12% AVD failure threshold (Sitar 3hr Cognitive failed at 12% — wrong lane×runtime). Sleep lane is the right place for 3hr per Finding 12. Surbahar's drone character should sustain the long form better than Sitar's plucked notes did.
experiment.success_criteria: AVD% 15%+ (sleep-lane AVD INVERTED — lower is better, means viewer fell asleep) AND views 5K+ within 7 days. Avg view duration 25min+ acceptable for sleep (Bansuri 3hr hero = 40min, but Bansuri owns that). Watch CTR also — 4%+ confirms thumb pulls.
experiment.failure_criteria: AVD < 8% (too low even for sleep — means viewers bounced, not slept) OR views < 1K (algorithm didn't push at all)
experiment.neutral_zone: Views 1-5K with healthy AVD = directional, may need second test with different sub-lane framing
